user.title: HA Dial Server
user.description:
Add one HA Dial Server for all your Dials. Each physical Dial must first be added through the ESPHome integration. Enable Allow the device to perform Home Assistant actions in its ESPHome options so the Dial can send input events.

After adding the server, refresh your browser. Open a dashboard, choose Edit dashboard → Add card → HA Dial, select your Dial from the dropdown, add its controls and save.

Existing dashboard cards can send their saved setup again when opened. Removing HA Dial Server deletes its saved screen definitions, but leaves dashboard cards unchanged.

abort.already_configured: HA Dial Server is already set up. One server manages all your Dials; add another HA Dial dashboard card to configure another Dial.
